about: Decision 0012 §2: the quests that may be running after a new game and after 1, 10 and 50 in-game days. Every other self-starting vanilla quest (start-game-enabled or started by the story manager, listed from the masters by ArgoniaGen quests) is generated as an inert shell override; the journey (0.4 §b) compares the running list with 'running'.
